f-a11y.1.evidence: guest /community/: first Tab lands on 'Skip to content' (#content); <main> landmark present

f-a11y.2.evidence: tabbed 90 stops on the space and topic pages in light and dark (prefers-color-scheme plus jt-dark): every stop has an outline or box-shadow ring after 210ms except the WordPress/Reign admin-bar search input (theme element, not Jetonomy); reading order follows the DOM except the header/admin-bar jump

f-a11y.3.evidence: icon-only controls all carry aria-label: Vote up/down (aria-pressed), Share (aria-expanded), Bookmark (aria-pressed), Report, Quote, composer toolbar (Code, Code block, Link, Blockquote, Upload Image, Insert emoji with aria-expanded), notifications bell, font-size and theme toggle; the Pro anonymous toggle needs Pro and was not on this stack

f-a11y.4.evidence: reply editor is role=textbox aria-label='Reply editor'; the new-topic title input label and poll option labels (Pro) were not inspected

f-a11y.5.evidence: vote buttons expose aria-pressed and 'Remove your upvote'; the enabled-state score announcement and reaction chips (Pro Reactions) were not read

f-a11y.6.evidence: Report on a reply opens a dialog labelled by 'jt-report-title' with a radio group of 5 reasons; focus lands on the first reason (spam), Tab stays inside the dialog across 14 presses, Escape closes it and focus returns to the Report control

f-a11y.7.evidence: moderation queue buttons are real <button>s named by aria-describedby to the target (Approve/Spam/Reject 'QA-RFT held topic N', Restore/Delete permanently, Lift restriction 'qa_rft_d'); confirms are role dialogs ('Reject this submission? ...'), not alert()

f-a11y.8.evidence: Share opens with Enter (aria-expanded true, 5 items), ArrowDown moves focus to the first item, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger; notifications bell opens with Space, Escape closes and returns focus

f-a11y.9.evidence: my contrast sampler could not resolve gradient/filled backgrounds (reported 1:1 on filled buttons), so no AA verdict; needs an axe or manual pass in light and dark

f-a11y.10.evidence: 390px with root font-size 200%: no horizontal overflow; no .jt-app button or action link under 40px tall or wide on the topic page

f-a11y.11.evidence: a11y-speak polite/assertive regions exist and form errors use role=alert; aria-describedby linkage of errors to their field was not checked

f-a11y.12.evidence: silenced refusal text 'Your account is currently silenced and cannot post.' verified over REST; how the disabled composer exposes it to assistive tech was not inspected

f-a11y.13.evidence: topic page: nav aria-label=Breadcrumb with aria-current=page; one h1; heading levels 1,2,3,3,4... no skips

f-a11y.14.evidence: front-end RTL needs a locale switch: a user's locale (set to ar) does not change the front-end language and the site locale must not be changed here; keyboard-only reply (editor -> Tab -> Post Reply -> Enter) works end to end in LTR
